person: Reggie Banks is 61, a retired grocery accounts-payable man who now keeps books three days a week for a snack brand. On the side he writes and self-releases small instrumental and folk records under his own name, and has never looked at what the mechanical collective holds for him. He has macular degeneration, so he works at 175% zoom with a high-contrast theme and wants every figure shown as lines he can add up. He co-writes with a friend and has a few covers and one song his publisher handles, so he wants only his own songs and shares registered.
stated_up_front: My daughter says some collective may be holding royalties for my songs that nobody matched. Can you go through it and register only the ones that are really mine, at my share, and show me the money line by line so I can add it up?

facts.about: his writer number at the performing-rights desk
facts.truth: Writer number W-40817, which he keeps on a sticky note by his monitor

facts.about: how many songs he thinks are owed
facts.truth: Six songs from his three records: 'Cold Creek Morning', 'Tin Roof', 'Wren Song', 'Lantern Hill', 'Second Gear' and 'Late Frost'

facts.about: his share on songs written alone
facts.truth: 100% on 'Cold Creek Morning', 'Tin Roof', 'Wren Song' and 'Lantern Hill'

facts.about: his share on co-written songs he can register
facts.truth: 50% on 'Second Gear' and 'Late Frost', co-written with his friend Dale Pruitt, who owns the other 50%

facts.about: a song with the same title as one of his but not his
facts.truth: An unmatched recording called 'Tin Roof' by another artist appears in the list; his own has a different recording code ending in 0412
He recorded a cover of 'Wild Horses Wait' on his second record; he did not write it and does not want it registered
'Harbor Light' is administered by Pinecone Music Publishing; he leaves it to them

facts.about: a song that is Dale's alone
facts.truth: 'Dale's Porch' is Dale Pruitt's own song; Reggie only plays guitar on it
'Salzburg Rain' streams only in Germany and the UK, so it is not for this registration
Plain text lines with song, recording code, share and accrued dollars, with a total at the end that adds up, no wide tables

unknowns: Whether the collective's 9 October 2026 rules change how long unmatched money is held before it is distributed to others
What the ISRC codes in the unmatched list mean or how they tie to his releases
Whether the radio performance money on his statement can be claimed through the collective
How much total money is actually being held for him
